InBody body composition

The scale doesn't
tell the whole story.

An InBody scan takes a few minutes and shows what your body is actually made of, so you can see real progress even when the scale doesn't move.

  • Muscle and fat mass, broken down by arms, legs and trunk
  • Body water, plus how your muscle compares to others your age
  • Included with every package. You can also book single scans or a scan package.

Meet your coach

A trainer who keeps it fun

Tedashi started out as a high school wrestler. When he came back to coach his old team, he asked why they were still lifting the same way he had years before. His coach told him he could change anything if he found a better way, so Tedashi got certified and found one.

  • Wrestling coach → first CPTGot certified to train his team better, then started training clients on the side.
  • Top trainer at Fitness 19His first personal training job, just down the street.
  • Master Trainer at 24 Hour FitnessCoached 8,000+ sessions over more than 5 years and was named one of the company's top 10 trainers.
  • Forever Body FitnessHis own studio, helping clients one session and one program at a time.
